title: Banked Register File
statement: Implement a banked register file with two 8-entry banks and one write port. The bank select signal chooses which bank receives writes. Reads should return values from both banks simultaneously on separate outputs.
module_signature: module banked_register_file(input clk, input rst, input write_en, input bank_sel, input [2:0] write_addr, input [7:0] write_data, input [2:0] read_addr_a, input [2:0] read_addr_b, output [7:0] read_data_a, output [7:0] read_data_b);
behavior: write_data is stored in the selected bank when write_en is 1.
read_data_a and read_data_b reflect their respective bank values.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use vendor-specific multi-bank memory macros.
hint: Model each bank as an independent register array.
